profile.headline: A hungry epistemophile. Feed me.
profile.summary:
Software engineering is less of a hobby or career, and more of an extension of my personality. 

I detest repetitive work, so automating it away is appealing to no end. I approach monolithic problems, both personally and professionally, by deconstructing them into microtasks and tackling them asynchronously. And I am constantly refactoring the way I do things to find the most efficient way possible. 

I love it. The meticulousness of it all, the intellectual satisfaction, and the juxtaposition of simplicity alongside sophistication. From electrical pulses of ones and zeros, to the abstractions that are the contemporary programming syntax we use today. In pursuit of my passion, I am constantly learning, and would love to connect with people who are as excited about obscure idiosyncrasies and as inspired by constraints as I am.
